scope: Distinct review IDs, same movie and source chunks, same top-k. Recall and MRR only use questions with judged relevant evidence. Rankings do not assess answer quality or abstention.
latency_scope: Warmed single-query retrieval includes query encoding and ranking. Corpus preparation and generation are excluded. Timings are local to this run.
